name: Standard Glass Lining Technology Ltd
about: Incorporated in September 2012, Standard Glass Lining Technology Limited is a manufacturer of engineering equipment for the pharmaceutical and chemical sectors in India.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview[1] Standard Glass is among the top 5 specialized engineering equipment manufacturers for pharmaceutical and chemical sectors in India (FY24 revenue basis). It provides end-to-end solutions including design, manufacturing, assembly, installation, and commissioning of equipment with over 65+ unique designs and over 11,000 units delivered.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 99.4 to 127 days.
Working capital days have increased from 172 days to 272 days
